internal.title: Incident Resolved: Cart Service High Error Rate
internal.body:
At 11:59 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service, reaching 25%. Initial diagnosis identified error injection as the primary fault type, supported by elevated error metrics. Latency issues were also observed but were secondary. Resource exhaustion was ruled out due to low CPU and memory usage.

The mitigation involved disabling the cartFailure flag at 12:19 UTC after approval. Post-action monitoring confirmed recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.002).

Timeline:
- 11:59:17 Alert received for high error rate
- 12:18:57 Diagnosis confirmed error injection
- 12:19:01 Flag disabled after approval
- 12:19:01 Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
